summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed Form 6-K to disclose a major holdings notification under Irish law, reporting that The Capital Group Companies, Inc. increased its voting rights above 17.00% (from 16.08% to 17.03%) as of July 16, 2026. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of a passive stake crossing, not a tender offer or an activist campaign. There are no deal terms, board recommendation, or merger mechanics involved. This is a standard ownership notification, not a special situation.
